methodology.title: 2.1 Core Principle: Contextual Location Linking
content: Problem: Students often confuse prepositions of location (in, on, at).

Solution: This week introduces "at" specifically anchored to public places and weekend activities (at the park, at the library). By consistently pairing the action verb with the location noun, students naturally acquire the "verb + at the + place" chunk.

methodology.title: 2.4 Teacher Notes: Pull-Out Tasks & Communicative Task
content: S1 pull-out: Show a place flashcard (e.g., park). Student must make a full sentence: "I am at the park."
S2 pull-out: Show an action flashcard (e.g., read). Student matches it to a place: "I read at the library."
Communicative task: Information Gap (Section 8). Student A knows where Max goes. Student B knows where Luna goes. They ask and answer to complete the weekend schedules.

games.name: Vocab Slam
games.session_fit: All formats — best after vocab intro (P3) in any session
games.materials: Vocab flashcards W11: park, library, supermarket, cinema, restaurant
instructions: Round 1: Teacher calls a Vietnamese meaning — first student to say the English word AND use it correctly in a sentence wins the card.
Round 2: Reverse — teacher calls English word, student gives Vietnamese + memory trick.
Bonus round: Students chain all vocab words (park, library, supermarket, cinema, restaurant) into one connected story using sequence connectors from this week.
Team variant: 2 teams, 10 cards per round. Team with highest score wins.

games.name: Grammar Relay
games.session_fit: Best in Drill slot (Slot 2) or after P4/P6 in 3-session mode
games.materials: 10 sentence cards — 5 correct, 5 with errors based on: Preposition "at" for places
instructions: Grammar focus this week: Preposition "at" for places.
Speed Read: Display sentence for 5 sec. Teams write C (correct) or E (error) on whiteboards simultaneously — no copying allowed.
Fix-It: For error sentences, team that corrects fastest AND explains the rule earns double points.
Build: Each team member adds 1 original sentence using the grammar target. The chain must be logically connected — each sentence must link to the previous.

games.name: Story Race
games.session_fit: All formats — best in final slot of the week (S3 / Slot 5 / Session B)
games.materials: Story starter card: theme "Community & Routines — Weekend Adventures"
instructions: Give each pair a story starter connected to this week's theme: "Community & Routines — Weekend Adventures".
Pair A adds 2 sentences — must include at least 2 vocab words from this week.
Pass to Pair B: they MUST correct any grammar mistake from Pair A first, then add 2 more sentences using different vocab words.
Final round: Each pair presents their story ending aloud. Class votes on most creative + most accurate (park, library, supermarket, cinema, restaurant usage). Teacher scores grammar precision.

teacher_contents.in_class_speaking:
IN-CLASS SPEAKING ACTIVITIES — Session 1 (teacher-led)

Activity 1 — Pair Speaking (3–5 min, pairs):
  Student A: State a place ("I go to the park").
  Student B: Add an action ("You play soccer at the park").

Challenge Extension (L3 — for advanced/older students):
  [O] L3 — Older: Fill in the blank with 3 options (10 items)
  I go _______________ (at / to / in) the park.
  She reads _______________ (at / to / on) the library.
  We buy food _______________ (at / to / under) the supermarket.
  He watches movies at the _______________ (cinema / chair / bed).
  They eat at a _______________ (restaurant / book / sky).
  I play soccer at the _______________ (park / apple / water).
  She sees books at the _______________ (library / tree / dog).
  We buy milk at the _______________ (supermarket / pen / ruler).
  I watch films at the _______________ (cinema / desk / bag).
  I eat dinner at a _______________ (restaurant / window / door).
  L4 — Sentence Expansion (10 items)
teacher_contents.vc_answer_key: [1] name [2] Monday [3] night [4] park [5] sleep [6] cats [7] fun [8] supermarket [9] read [10] up [11] eat [12] read [13] book

listening_script.text: Tom plays at the park. He runs fast. Max buys food at the supermarket. He buys red apples. They are very active on the weekend.
dictation: Tom plays at the park." "He buys red apples.

  I _______________ (play / buy / watch) games.

  We _______________ (buy / read / watch) apples.

listening_script.text: Tom has a great weekend. He plays at the park. He reads at the library. He buys food at the supermarket. He eats at a restaurant. His weekend is perfect!
